name: iSpv
description: This server provides fast access to official information about Romanian companies based on their CUI (unique identification number). You can retrieve general company details such as company name, registered office address, registration status, CAEN code, VAT payer status (including applicable periods), and inactivity status. The server also supports querying annual financial statement data for one or multiple fiscal years, including assets, liabilities, equity, turnover, profit or loss, and number of employees.

_published_faq.name: How do I add iSpv to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add iSpv to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ispv.ro/mcp/public.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the iSpv MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: iSpv provides these MCP tools: cui_info_tool and cui_bilant_tool.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to iSpv?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to iSpv in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
iSpv does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
iSpv is developed by Andali Solutions Pro SRL. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
